description: This file defines a centralized type alias 'MockFn' for mocking functions in Vitest tests. It helps avoid exporting inferred 'vi.fn()' types that could trigger TypeScript error TS2742, ensuring more predictable test mock types within the project.

ctags.name: MockFn
ctags.pattern: /^export type MockFn<T extends (...args: any[]) => any = (...args: any[]) => any> =$/
